top_signal.title: How to save struggling family owned business?
top_signal.summary: I work for a family owned pool maintenance and construction company that’s been struggling financially for a while. Multiple employees haven’t received their full paychecks in months and things are getting worse now that winter is approaching and business is slowing down.  We have loans to pay, customer refunds owed, legal expenses, and potential large projects that likely won’t start until spring. We’re even considering taking out another loan just to keep things going. The employees are loyal and want to make things work, and the owners are starting to realize that changes need to be made. I really want to help, but I’m struggling to find ways to bring in money during the winter.   For anyone with small business or pool industry experience; What services could we offer during the winter to generate income? How do other seasonal businesses survive their slow months? What would you prioritize to bring in steady cash flow and keep the business afloat?   I’m looking for realistic, actionable advice or ideas we might not have considered. I genuinely want to help save this business and the jobs of the people who work here       submitted by     /u/ImEmbarassingMyself       [link]       [comments]
